# Phase 06.11 Plan 10: Supporting Systems Summary

**28 GBC palette definitions, 16 status icon constants, 31 SFX delegates, and 3-slot save system — all supporting systems ready for scene wiring**

## Performance

- **Duration:** ~8 min
- **Started:** 2026-02-27T12:21:37Z
- **Completed:** 2026-02-27T12:29:37Z
- **Tasks:** 2
- **Files created:** 4

## Accomplishments

### Task 1: Palettes.kt and StatusIcons.kt

Created `Palettes.kt` with 28 `GBCPalette` instances across all visual contexts:

- **Floor palettes (floors 1-8):** 3 palettes per floor-pair (tile base, chests, special objects) × 4 floor-pairs = 24 background palettes total (floor1-floor8)
- **Battle palettes:** `battleBg0`, `battleMonster1`, `battleHpNormal`, `battleHpCritical`, `battleSpBar`, `battleUi` (background) + `battleBuff`, `battleDebuff` (sprite palette 6/7)
- **Death fade sequence:** 6 discrete sprite palettes (`deathFade0`–`deathFade5`) matching palette.c fade progression from full color to pure white
- **Title screen:** `titleDragonFace`, `titleDragonBody`, `titleFire`, `titleSmoke` (sprite) + `titleBg`, `titlePressStart` (background)

All background palettes explicitly set `type = PaletteType.BACKGROUND` (GBCPalette defaults to SPRITE).

Created `StatusIcons.kt` with:
- `TILE_BASE = 0x60`, `ICONS_PER_COMBATANT = 4`, `TOTAL_ICONS = 16`
- `BUFF_PALETTE_INDEX = 6`, `DEBUFF_PALETTE_INDEX = 7`
- OAM slot constants for all 16 icons (player icon 1-4, monster 1-3 icon 1-4)
- Screen position constants for each combatant's icon row

### Task 2: Sounds.kt and SaveSystem.kt

Created `Sounds.kt` with:
- `LabyrinthSounds` data class holding 31 `SoundRef` typed refs with KDoc `@source` cross-references
- `GameBuilder.defineSounds()` extension function that registers all 31 `soundEffect {}` delegates in game scope
- SFX mapped to appropriate `SoundPreset` values: BUMP (stairs, wallHit, menuMove), COIN (lightFire, openChest), HIT (bigDoorOpen, startBattle, meleeAttack), WIN (battleSuccess, levelUp, heroSelected), LOSE (falling, battleDeath), POWERUP (actionSurge, heal, bigPowerup, midPowerup), SHOOT (monsterAttack2, magicMissile), etc.
- sfx_hero_selected and sfx_neshacker_presents documented as aliases to battleSuccess/magicMissile

Created `SaveSystem.kt` with:
- `SAVE_ID = "labyrinth_save"` constant
- `register(builder)` helper that configures `slots(3)`, `checksum()`, `version(1)`
- Complete documentation of all 12 saved GameState variables (floor, position, torch, keys, class) and 5 excluded transient UI state variables
- V2 format compatibility note: no binary compatibility with Original SRAM layout

## Decisions Made

- `Palettes` object stores `GBCPalette` instances directly rather than using the `palette { }` delegate DSL. The delegate DSL registers palettes into the game IR, but palettes referenced by name in scene enter blocks work equally well as standalone objects passed to scene builder APIs.
- `defineSounds()` follows the `defineCharacters()` GameBuilder extension function pattern from `Characters.kt` — this ensures `soundEffect {}` delegates are called inside the active `GameBuilderContext` thread-local.
- `SaveSystem.register()` wraps the `saveData()` call in an object — the existing `saveData()` in `LabyrinthOfTheDragon.kt` will be replaced by `SaveSystem.register(this)` when the scene wiring plans complete.
- Death fade uses 6 discrete palette snapshots rather than an animation DSL — the battle scene frame handler applies each step on a timer, matching the `update_fade_out()` step-by-step progression in `palette.c`.
